jobs.title: Online Consumer Insights Panelist. Hiring Now. Part Time Office Assistant Welcome
jobs.description:
Job Description

ApexFocusGroup collaborates with research firms, universities, and trusted brands to gather genuine consumer insights. We help connect everyday people with flexible online, part time market research opportunities that influence real products, services, and customer experiences. Role Overview :We are welcoming participants from all backgrounds, including anyone looking for office assistant roles, to take part as an online consumer insights panelist. These may involve online discussions, product testing, or feedback sessions - typically conducted remotely online.This is a casual, project-based opportunity ideal for anyone interested in taking part in research on a part time basis, depending on their availability and profile fit. We are hiring now and some studies are available for immediate start. Requirements :Access to a smartphone, tablet, or computer with a functional cameraReliable internet connectionAbility to read instructions carefully and provide honest, detailed feedbackAn active email address to receive study invitations and participation detailsBenefits:Take part only in studies that match your interests and scheduleResearch types include online or in-person focus groups, virtual interviews, product testing, and other feedback activitiesNo previous office assistant experience needed. Just a willingness to share your opinionsSome studies may include early access to new products or services before launchMany studies offer compensation, which varies by study type and durationCompensation:Up to £700 per week (amount varies based on the selected focus group or research assignment)If you'd like to contribute to research that influences real-world products and decisions, or simply looking for flexible part time online roles, we invite you to submit your interest online today.Important Notice – No Fees Required: Participation is always free. We never request or accept any fees for registration or study involvement. Please stay cautious and only respond to communications sent directly from us.

jobs.title: Part-Time HR Coordinator
jobs.description:
Job Description

Job Specification - Part-Time HR Coordinator Location: Leeds, Yorkshire Industry: HVAC Installation, Servicing & Maintenance / Building Services Position: HR Coordinator Employment Type: Part-time Role Overview We are looking for an organised, proactive and personable Part-Time HR Coordinator to join our established and growing HVAC and building services business in Leeds. The company specialises in HVAC installation, servicing and maintenance, supporting commercial and building services projects across the region. This is a hands-on HR coordination role supporting both our office-based team and engineers working across customer sites. The successful candidate will take ownership of day-to-day HR administration while supporting recruitment, onboarding, employee records, training, compliance and general employee matters. Key Responsibilities HR Administration Maintain accurate and confidential employee records. Manage personnel files, employment documentation and HR records. Prepare contracts, offer letters and other HR correspondence. Maintain holiday, sickness and absence records. Monitor probation periods and key employee dates. Assist with employee reviews and HR processes. Keep HR systems and databases up to date. Ensure HR documentation is completed accurately and on time. Maintain confidentiality when dealing with employee information.Recruitment Coordinate recruitment for HVAC engineers, service engineers, maintenance engineers, apprentices and office-based positions. Prepare and advertise job vacancies. Manage applications and shortlist suitable candidates. Arrange interviews with managers. Communicate with candidates throughout the recruitment process. Coordinate references and right-to-work checks. Assist with pre-employment checks and documentation. Maintain a pipeline of potential candidates for future vacancies. Onboarding & New Starters Coordinate the complete new-starter process. Prepare employment documentation and starter packs. Arrange inductions. Ensure new employees receive company policies and procedures. Coordinate required training and competency checks. Ensure engineers have the appropriate documentation, qualifications and certifications before commencing work. Monitor probation periods and provide reminders to managers. Training & Competency Records Because we operate within the HVAC and building services sector, maintaining accurate training and competency records is an important part of the role. Responsibilities will include: Maintaining training and qualification records. Monitoring expiry dates for relevant certificates. Booking refresher training where required. Liaising with training providers. Supporting managers with employee training requirements . Maintaining records for technical, health & safety and industry-related qualifications. Ensuring managers are alerted to upcoming certification renewals.Employee Support Act as a first point of contact for routine HR queries. Provide employees with information on company policies and procedures. Support managers with employee-related matters. Assist with absence and attendance processes. Support employee engagement initiatives. Help maintain a positive and professional workplace culture. Escalate more complex HR or employee relations matters appropriately.Payroll & Administration Support Assist with the preparation and checking of payroll information. Maintain accurate records of holidays, sickness, overtime and other relevant information. Liaise with payroll providers or the finance team. Assist with payroll queries where appropriate. Maintain accurate employee information for payroll purposes. We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity in our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status

jobs.title: Health & Safety Officer - Part Time
jobs.description:
Job Description

Location: Bradford, BD4 Division: Engineering – SWIFT Temps Ltd, Bradford Office Salary: £31,000 – £39,000 per annum pro rata (PAYE) + Holiday Accrual Job Type: Part-Time | 12-Week Temp-to-Perm SWIFT Temps Ltd is currently recruiting on behalf of our valued manufacturing client in Bradford BD4 for an experienced Part-Time Health & Safety Officer. This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced H&S professional looking for a flexible part-time position, with working hours potentially suited to those seeking school term-time working arrangements. About the Role Our client is seeking an experienced Health & Safety Officer to join their manufacturing site in Bradford. You will play a key role in promoting a strong Health, Safety and Environmental culture, ensuring compliance with UK legislation and company standards, while providing practical advice and support to the site management team. Ideally, you will have experience within a manufacturing, engineering or machinery-based environment, with a good understanding of PUWER (Provision and Use of Work Equipment Regulations) and machinery safety. Key Responsibilities * Implement and monitor H&S policies, procedures and risk assessments. * Conduct regular site inspections and H&S audits. * Investigate accidents, incidents and near misses and recommend appropriate corrective actions. * Ensure compliance with current UK H&S legislation and relevant industry standards. * Maintain accurate H&S records, documentation and reports. * Develop and maintain emergency procedures and coordinate emergency drills. * Arrange testing, servicing and maintenance of H&S equipment. * Provide guidance on PPE, machinery safety and safe working practices. * Support the management of PUWER assessments and machinery-related safety requirements . * Lead regular H&S meetings with the site leadership team. * Monitor PPM schedules and ensure inspections, servicing and statutory checks are completed on time. * Identify opportunities for continual improvement in H&S standards and working practices. * Provide practical H&S advice and guidance to employees and management. About You The successful candidate will ideally have: * IOSH Managing Safely or equivalent H&S qualification. * NEBOSH Certificate is preferred but not essential. * Previous experience working in a Health & Safety role, ideally within manufacturing, engineering or a similar environment. * Experience or knowledge of machinery safety and PUWER. * Good knowledge of UK Health & Safety legislation and best practice. * Strong communication and interpersonal skills. * Good organisational and problem-solving abilities. * The ability to identify workplace risks and implement practical solutions. * Good IT and Microsoft Office skills. First Aid and Fire Safety qualifications are desirable but not essential. Working Hours & Flexibility * 15–25 hours per week * Flexible working hours available * School term-time working may be considered for the right candidate * Part-time hours to be agreed with the successful applicant and client What's on Offer? £31,000 – £39,000 per annum pro rata Part-time, flexible working Potential school term-time arrangement 12-week temp-to-perm opportunity Free on-site parking Bradford-based manufacturing environment Long-term permanent opportunity for the right candidate Holiday pay accrued separately How to Apply If you are an experienced Health & Safety professional looking for a flexible part-time opportunity within a manufacturing environment, we would be keen to hear from you. Please send your CV to Mcmillan Serrant at SWIFT Temps Ltd – Bradford Office. Phone: (phone number removed) INDBR
